title: MG: Ascension, check out my latest project.
author: superflyingcobra
selftext:
Hello Ai game dev’s i’ve made my game entirely without AI assistance, however I’ve noticed that AI may be able to drastically boost my production in terms of VFX, Animations!?(PLEASE say I can create animations), and Voicelines. 

I’m super excited and grateful there’s a community as supportive of new game devs and pushing for a greater gaming tool experience.

Please recommend, sell, or donate any assets you think would fit in well. My game is based on Modern 2025, if humans had powers. Graphics will resembles uncharted 4 / gta 4.
